name: Umberto Maglioli
features: olive skin, dark hair combed back, dark deep-set eyes, lean lined face, high cheekbones, wiry build, quiet stoic expression
bio: The road-race specialist of his generation: three Targa Florio wins spread over fifteen years, two of them taken single-handed, plus the 1954 Carrera Panamericana and Sebring in 1964. A hillclimb crash in 1957 left his legs so badly broken that the doctors doubted he would walk, and he raced for another thirteen years afterwards.
